final: WITH c AS (SELECT a.district_id AS district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM disp p JOIN account a ON a.account_id = p.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_share, 1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS overall_share FROM c ORDER BY overall_share DESC, district_id LIMIT 10
